english.title: Walk etc on escalator in wrong direction on Transport for London road transport premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst on Transport for London road transport premises at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) used or attempted to use an escalator other than by standing or walking on it in the direction intended for travel
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 10(3) and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
whilst on Transport for London road transport premises
used/attempted to use an escalator other than by standing/walking on it in the direction intended for travel

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst on Transport for London road transport premises at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) the defendant used or attempted to use an escalator other than by standing or walking on it in the direction intended for travel.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
